notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Patch Notes (Controller Support)
notes.notes:
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Dead Oculus now has controller support for Xbox, PS4/DualShock, and PS5/DualSense controllers!

The newly added controller support also supports dual wielding, so if you want to move with your controller but aim with your mouse, you can do that.  You can even aim with one controller and move with another!  Dead Oculus will simply read the strongest signal of each button for every plugged in controller.

Please mind these limitations:
- Controller binds are not rebindable
- Wireless Bluetooth has not yet been tested for DualShock/DualSense controllers*
- Dead Oculus does not have Steam controller integration
- 3rd party controllers [i]might[/i] work, but if it doesn't full conform to DirectInput or XInput, will read random junk inputs (in which case you might want to unplug that controller)
- Nintendo Controllers are not supported and will not be registered unless the operating system fails to recognize that that controller is a Nintendo product, in which case Dead Oculus [b]will[/b] read junk inputs from that controller
- For GX.Games customers: The right thumbstick does not work, as browsers have restrictions on automatically moving the cursor (which is what the right thumbstick does)

The demo has also been updated, so if you are unsure if your controller will cooperate with Dead Oculus, you can test it in the demo.

[h3]Fix[/h3]
- Fixed a typo where "select ability" was displayed instead of "select boon"

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Just a few fixes and minor changes.  Merry Christmas & Happy Holidays!

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Slightly reduced the gain of The Rauser's reload to 91% of its original value, it was a bit loud
- Made the introduction tutorial slightly clearer

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed achievement descriptions on Steam (the endless achievements incorrectly stated that you need 15 arenas clear, whereas the real value is 10)
- Fixed a bug where enemies that *could* be immortal, but weren't, still said "Shredded!" even when they had no armour to shred
- Fixed a bug where the game would incorrectly pluralise "1 Eyeballs Remaining" intead of saying "1 Eyeball Remaining"

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce that Dead Oculus will be releasing on November 4th, 2024!

The full version of Dead Oculus will be releasing on both Steam & GX.games; you can find the portal to the GX.games version here: [url=https://gx.games/games/dnhcgq/dead-oculus/]https://gx.games/games/dnhcgq/dead-oculus/[/url]

Dead Oculus is also participating in Steam Next Fest.  If you haven't already, feel free to try the demo either on Steam, or through the GX.games link above!

- Andrew Wilker

notes.title: Demo v10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Endless Mode now takes 3|6|10|15 arenas for Bronze|Silver|Gold|Nazar medals (from 5|10|15|20 arenas)
- Lowered Degressless boon time 20 -> 15 seconds
- Lowered Eye of Horus boon time 30 -> 10 seconds
- Lowered number of raindrop projectiles that spawn in the Skeleton boss fight
- Slightly lowered tank boss health

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where the game would crash when you press the exit button

notes.title: Demo v9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Lowered Machine Gun reload volume
- Reduced boss health scaling: +25%pt. increase -> +20%pt. increase per danger level
- Gun and Ability gallery now stay on the right side of the hub (to make room for unlocks that come after the demo)
- Added new icons for left-hand-side unlocks on the Victory screen
- The difficulty description now contains much more information
- GX.games only: Added challenges
- Added Nazars, medals for extraordinarily fast times in areas
- Updated the save folder name and added Steam Cloud support (unfortunately, due to the folder name change you will have a fresh save when you play the updated version of the demo)

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where the Executioner boon would cause knives to phase through snake boss segments after a segment had taken damage from bullets
- Fixed an issue where the game would crash if snake crystal projectiles were on the screen when it completed its death animation
- Fixed a bug where particles would not be cleared before heading into the loot/victory/loss screen
- Fixed a bug where some sprites could be seen past the room boundaries if they were drawn far enough out (this also fixes the thin layer of purple that could be seen on The Bunkus)
- Fixed a bug where dodging would use an imprecise collision mask
- Fixed a bug where pressing escape and the "play" button in the main menu simultaneously would deactivate all entities in the game

[h3]Notes on the Save Folder Change[/h3]
- If you would like to continue your demo save from before this update, open %localappdata% and copy the files from "\DeadOculus2"* into "\Dead_Oculus",* overwriting any duplicate .txt files
* This is not a typo, the folder with the '2' in its name is the old folder

notes.title: Demo v8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]New Boons[/h3]
- Eye of Horus: Added to the demo (Get a second chance at living if you enter a zone fast enough)
- IDDQD: Added to the demo (Invincibility at the start of an arena)

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Added icons for all item types
- Balanced the revolver audio
- There are now impact sounds when a knife hits an enemy
- Tutorial exits are 3 seconds faster
- Made the scaling on the skeleton boss's zones asymptotic (it took far too long to beat in the later stages of endless mode), its summons' health and is increased and gem output decreased to balance this out
- Snake boss's scales now persist into the second phase

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a typo
- The snake boss's full body and head now count as a single hitbox (grenading both the head and the body will no longer do double damage)
- Fixed a problem where particles from gems would sometimes cover the gem

[h3]Known Issue[/h3]
- There is a bug where if you hold left mouse button, alt-tab, then tab back into the game, the crosshair will stop updating its position unless you hold left mouse button
[strike]- This fix will be delayed to the full release as it's an engine level bug which requires updating the game to a newer runtime[/strike]
Edit: It seems like this fix would require a disporportionately large rewrite -- in relation to how harmless and easily avoidable this bug is -- majorly delaying Dead Oculus's release date.  It not be fixed by release ːsteamsadː

notes.title: Demo v7 Patch Notes (12 New Items)
notes.notes:
I've been working on finalizing the boons in the game.
This update brings a small selection of the new boons to the demo, along with some improvements to the current ones.

[h3]Item Changes[/h3]
- Secret Passages: Added to the demo (allows you to dodge through walls)
- Insanity Shuffle: Added to the demo (gives you a speed boost after you dodge)
- Adrenaline: Added to the demo (shoot faster based on your missing health)
- Thorns: Added to the demo (create bullets around you when damaged)
- Ankh Rune: Added to the demo (become invincible for 1 second every 3 seconds)
- Murder Slits: Added to the demo (create bullets when walking near walls)
- Pillbox: Added to the demo (create bullets while standing on a zone)
- Rift Daggers: Added to the demo (create daggers in random locations when you shoot)
- Finger of Death: Added to the demo (any enemy you touch while dodging explode)
- Demon Bullets: Added to the demo (any bullets created while you are on a zone become explosive)
- Magnetic Daggers: Added to the demo (when you dodge, execute all knived enemies below 4 tiers of health)
- The Weasel (Gun): Added to the demo (6-shot revolver, innately has the bullet bounce boon)
- Changed the unlock ordering (so some of the above items will only be useable with certain eyeball counts in the demo)
- Wound particles are now gold when you have the Nuclear Halo boon equipped
- Updated Event Horizon visuals

- Takyon: Removed from the demo
- McCreep: Removed from the demo
- Knife Mail: Removed from the demo
- Donkalor Mavis: Removed from the demo
- Event Horizon: Removed from the demo
- Knife God: Removed from the demo
- Glass Cannon: Removed from the demo

[h3]Balance[/h3]
- Tenacious: no longer grants invincibility after dodging
- Tenacious: no longer procs when a shield is broken
- Tenacious: now lasts for 4 seconds flat
- Increased moving dodge range by 1/2 a tile

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Overkilling an enemy with 2 or more knives on the same frame no longer eats up the additional knives
- Fixed an issue where zone spawns would delay the next enemy wave from spawning

notes.title: Demo v6 Patch Notes

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

notes.title: Demo v5 Patch Notes (Endless Mode)
notes.notes:
In celebration of Steam's Endless Replayability Fest, the Dead Oculus demo now contains the Endless Conquest gamemode.

You can view the other changes from this patch below.

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
- Updated enemy colours to fit the rest of the colour palette (they are now silver instead of grey)
- Drop pod flames are now the colour of the enemy type it contains
- Renamed "Zones" to "Areas" in the level select screen

[h3]Balance[/h3]
- SMG damge 0.14 tiers -> 0.16 tiers
- Boomerang Bullets no longer deal additional damage
- Ricochet now deals double damage
- Ricochet maximum bounces 4 -> 2
- Bullet Virus now consumes ammo
- Knife fracture now breaks into 3 bullets (was 5); the bullets' angle is now reflected from the knife and the wall it hits
- Reduced blaze bulwark fireball count on both sides by 1
- Sped up explosive timer on tesla bulwark & infantry projectiles: 2.53 seconds -> 1.9 seconds
- Reordered some unlocks

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bias that caused your hamsa to point towards zones to the South-East of your character more frequently
- Fixed a bug where acid bulwarks would have a chance to immediately shoot when spawning

notes.title: Demo v4 Patch Notes (Play Zones 2-3)
notes.notes:
This update applies some changes from a round of playtesting and adds some sound work from the yet-to-be-released full version.
Most importantly, it makes it much clearer how to progress to zones 2 & 3.  This was the largest pain point in the previous version, as a majority of players thought the demo ended at zone 1.

[h3]Sound[/h3]
- The demo should now have full sound coverage

[h3]Balance[/h3]
- Boomerang bullets: Deal an extra tier of damage on the way back -> Deal double damage on the way back

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where the player could get a stationary projectile in "The Tutorial" to spawn out of bounds, forcing them to restart the game

[h3]Confusion Reduction Measures[/h3]
- When there's an odd number of eye-cons on the mission select screen, they're now rotated such that the vertically furthest eye-con appears at the bottom of the screen instead of the top
- Boon sub-menus on the boon gallery now have the title "view only" instead of their category name
- Integrated the tutorials as the first mission in their respective zone
- After finishing a tutorial you can replay it in the new "Practice" sub-menu (replacing the "How to Play" sub-menu)

notes.title: Demo v3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This patch is meant to fix some pain points found after the GX.games demo release, but is also applicable to the PC version

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
- You can now change your resolution to 1920x1080 even if your monitor doesn't support it
- Removed some boss entrance zones that were in annoying locations
- Made the gem collection sound more recognizable and audible
- Reduced game size by removing unused sound files, and compressed the music (This did not reduce the quality of the music, they are uncompressed before playing)

notes.title: Demo v2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
In preparing for Dead Oculus's 1.0 release, there were a few improvements that the game's demo could also benefit from.

[h3]Sound[/h3]
- Vastly expanded the game's sound coverage
- Readjusted mastering on the audio -- sound volume is now balanced for 50%, so you may have to update your sound settings

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
- Your equipped items now automatically display in item selection screens
- Boss spawn zones are now coloured
- New players are now given a prompt to let them know that the pause menu exists
- Made the text on the demo completion screen go by much quicker
- Wishlist button now opens the store page directly on the Steam overlay
- The demo can now be playable in browser on GX.Games
- Other minor improvements

[h3]Balance[/h3]
- Reduced SMG damage 0.2 -> 0.14 tiers of damage
- Increased Machine Gun reload speed 3.0 -> 2.0 seconds

notes.title: Change in Release Date
notes.notes:
Dead Oculus is set to release in September of 2022, but it's October 8th.  What's going on?

Unfortunately, Dead Oculus has been delayed due to some artistic constraints.

The game is currently in a state where all the core gameplay systems are complete, but surrounding systems which ensure a good gameplay experience (such as menus, sound design, and art) are not currently at a quality that meets my standards.

For this reason, rather than rushing to release the project in September, I decided to silently push the release a few days into October, but this is taking longer than expected.  Therefore, I have made the hard decision to delay the game for a short period of time.

To clarify, Dead Oculus is still in active development, nearly complete, and will be released in the near future.

Thanks
- Andrew, the sole developer of Dead Oculus
